---
title: "Garman-Kohlhagen European Currency Option Pricing"
subtitle: "From Theory to Implementation: A Complete PDE Analysis"
---

## Welcome

This project presents a comprehensive analysis of the **Garman-Kohlhagen model** for pricing European currency options. We bridge theoretical finance with computational methods, providing both analytical solutions and numerical implementations.

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
## Project Overview
This work extends the Black-Scholes framework to foreign exchange markets, treating the foreign interest rate as a continuous dividend yield. We derive the governing PDE from first principles and validate three finite difference schemes against closed-form solutions.
:::

## Key Features

- ✓ **Complete Mathematical Framework** - From stochastic dynamics to PDE
- ✓ **Analytical Solutions** - Garman-Kohlhagen closed-form formulas
- ✓ **Three Numerical Methods** - FTCS, BTCS, and Crank-Nicolson schemes
- ✓ **Rigorous Validation** - Stability analysis and convergence studies
- ✓ **Practical Applications** - Greeks computation and delta hedging
- ✓ **Performance Benchmarking** - Accuracy vs. computational cost
